1 The page

1.1 Sheet and margins

data-print="a4" or "letter" names the page the paper prints on: the sheet, its margins and a print scale of 0.8 that keeps two columns on the text width.

1.2 Page numbers

Every page but the first carries its number at the foot, in the page's bottom margin.

2 The breaks

2.1 Where a page ends

A .typeset-break before a block starts it on a new page - in print only; a screen has no pages. Choose the breaks from the printed pages, not in advance.

2.2 What may split

Figures, tables and listings stay whole. data-break-inside="allow" lets a long one run on into the next column or page, its frame closed on every piece.

3 What stays on screen

The contents list, a citation's format tabs and copy button, a comparison's divider: printed, each gives way to what paper can show.
